reviewed_by: Claude: harness shutdown revision race, focused shutdown and harness-switch selection
reason: HarnessRuntimeService.shutdown read each still-open harness turn and wrote it INTERRUPTED with the revision it read. The turn's own finishing task could save it in between, so the write raised RevisionConflict, which escaped shutdown before it cancelled the remaining chat and mission tasks. That made test_saved_harness_switch_binds_on_next_message_in_disposable_core flaky on main and could leave tasks alive for the thread guard. Shutdown now re-reads on conflict: a turn that settled keeps its outcome, one still open is retried on its fresh revision (bounded), and a conflict never escapes. Select the new deterministic regression test that forces the interleaving, the existing shutdown-while-connecting test, the harness turn lifecycle suite, and the previously flaky disposable-Core harness switch test.
exclusions: No UI, setting, provider or native change, so frontend, Playwright and native layers are empty and the settings assistant is unchanged. Other test_harnesses.py cases do not exercise shutdown's per-turn interrupt. No full-suite approval.
